item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description: - `deploys status --json` carries the shared `phase` of each project. VS Code extension 0.2.0: every platform, not only Vercel and Render; failed and building from `phase`; a name on two platforms is passed as `platform:name`; a hint when no project matches the folder. - Observer mode also refuses `guard` and `autofix --only` (without `--dry-run`); both change something. An approval check on a GitLab-linked Vercel project says that approvals are read from GitHub only. - Command palette: in observer mode (Settings → Team) it offers no deploy, rollback or "deploy all changed", like the window. - Ask Claude → Explain this failure: its button is now "Fix with Claude", the same as on the row (same caps, setup offer and toast). - Updates via Sparkle 2: the app reads https://deploycenter.app/appcast.xml once a day (Settings can turn it off) and on "Check for Updates …", accepts a download only with a valid EdDSA signature and the same Developer ID, and installs once no deploy is running. Replaces the old GitHub release check and "Update now". The Homebrew cask says `auto_updates true`.
